# SEO-068: Expose primary navigation links in the document without a user gesture

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Confidence | `HIGH` |

## Statement

The links that make up the site's primary navigation are present in the delivered document, not added only after a hover, click, scroll, or consent interaction.

## Rationale

Automated fetchers do not perform gestures, so navigation that materializes only on interaction is absent from the document they see and the sections it leads to lose their main discovery path.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Render menu markup with its anchors in the initial document and use CSS or script only to control visibility. For a menu populated from an API, render the same link set server-side or provide a linked sitemap page that covers the destinations.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Compare the set of anchors present before any interaction with the set present after opening every navigation control.
- Evidence: `RAW_HTML`, `BROWSER`, `RENDERED_HTML`
- Automated check: none.

## Scope

- Search surfaces: `GOOGLE_SEARCH`, `BING_SEARCH`
- Frameworks: `any`
- Caution: none recorded.
